method: Independent read-only review of the changes, required instructions, callers, relevant surrounding code, tests, and saved logs. All read commands completed. No files changed and no checks rerun.
assessment_weight: Each assessment has equal authority to block acceptance.

evidence.assessment: Gallery startup restores appearance and constructs sample screens without invoking production startup. The actual-entry test observes preference reads and native service calls across startup, lifecycle changes, and removal.
Catalog restoration still starts before other sources finish opening. Migration, recovery notices, cache-first refresh, and supplied catalog ownership retain their existing coordination.
Production retains media flushes, desktop exit saves, sync scheduling, reader lifecycle, and hearing disposal. RecordSyncScope remains above the navigator at line 417.
Shared appearance behavior preserves platform brightness, automatic appearance, reduced motion, controller replacement, and suspension.
Done uses the existing glass title action, whose closing behavior is implemented in lib/catalog/glass.dart:258. The saved regression test verifies visibility and dismissal at large text size.

gaps: Runtime evidence comes from saved builder logs, not reviewer execution.
Native platform behavior and visual acceptance remain unverified; this review makes no new acceptance claim.

evidence: Production startup and shared appearance code contain no gallery flags or development imports. Gallery startup and fixture composition reside in the gallery entry and development code.
Existing sample screens and actions remain in lib/development/gallery.dart. Updated tests retain sample interaction coverage and add saved sample-city verification.
Production reader preparation and the boo-j7gh speech word-reader callback are unchanged.
Saved red evidence shows two behavioral failures: unnecessary gallery preference reads and an unreachable Done action. Neither failure depends on missing symbols or source-text assertions.
Saved results report focused 138 passed; affected 908 passed with 3 skips; full suite 3540 passed with 27 skips; affected analysis clean; changed-file format clean.
The full-suite log includes the final migration and failed-startup tests. The earlier focused log contains an interim test name and is not treated as proof of every final test.
The committed caller audit covers the affected production, gallery, test, and macOS integration callers. The ticket remains open for parent integration.
gaps: Coverage, mutation testing, user acceptance, integration, and closure remain with the parent as specified.
External plugin, corpus, and benchmark checks skipped by the saved suite remain unverified.
